translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Tesalonicenses
book.title: Tesalónicagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Tesalonicenses

content: Gwage-swilidikidgi be nanamar

Emigindi gwenadgan, Dummad-Jesús-nuggi anmar bemarga ise-wilesagwar sogsun, degi, bemar-unamarsun: Ar igi anmar bemar-odurdaksa, bemar igi gudiguele, Bab Dummad nabir-ito imake, deyob bemar gatik bur-bule nanamarsun.
Ar bato bemar wisid, igi anmar Dummad-Jesús-nuggi bemarga sogsamala.
Bab Dummad unnila egarbi gwage-swilidik nanadii bemar-abemaid. Degisoggu, mer neg-sichigi na abirgunagwarsuli yolemalo.
Bemar wala-walagwen unnila be-ome-ebo nanadii be imakmarsun. Gwage-swilidikidgi, degi, nued-binsaedgi be-ome-sedii be gumarsun.
Melle be-omegi galagwensuli binsae be nanamalo, dulemar-Bab-Dummad-wichurmalad nanamaladyob.
An bemar-walik gudigu, bato an bemarga we-igar sogsamalad, we-igargi mer na gwenad-bensudii nanamaloye. Ar Bab Dummad beedse dulemar-degi-gudimalad-odurdakoed.
Ar Bab Dummad anmarse gochagua, igar-iskanaba-nanaega anmarse gochasulid, anmarse gochad, gwage-swilidik nanaegar.
Degisoggu, ar doa-dule we-igar istar dak-dibe, dule-istar-daksulid, Bab-Dummad-istar-daked, ar ade Bab Dummad anmarga E-Burba-Nued-uksad.
Na-gwenadgan-sabgumalad-igargindi an bemarse narmaked itolesulid, ar bemar-sunnad Bab Dummadgi be durdaksamalad, na be muchub-muchub sabgumarye.
Ar bato deyobi bela gwenadgan-Macedoniagi-bukmalad bemar imakbukwad. Unnila an bemarga, ise-wilesagwar sogsun, gatik bur-bule gwenadgan be sabgumaloye.
Bogidik be emar-abargi gudisamar, mer dule-baidgi yoledigumar, unnila be-ibmarbi be imakdisamar. Igi anmar bemar-odurdaksamala, deyob na be arbamar,
adi dulemar-Bab-Jesúsba-naisurmalad be-nug odummomalagar, degine, bela bemar ibmar-bina-sogedi be nika-gudigumalagar.
Bab-Jesús-gannar-danikoed-igar

Gwenadgan, dulemar-Jesúsba-nagusmalad-burgwismalad igi guoe, a-igar bemar wisii-gudii an be-abemardo, adi mer bemar dule-baigan-Bab-negse-dogosurmalad bukib-binsadamaladyob be dogdar bukib binsamarmogagar.
Ar igi anmar bensurmala, Jesús burgwisad, degine, gannar durgusad, debayobi anmar bensurbalid, Bab Dummad dule-Jesúsgi-bensurmalad-burgwismalad Jesúsba gannar durgus sedanibaloed.
A-ular anmar bemarga sogsunnad, Bab-Jesús sogeyob, anmar amba we-napneggi dula gudii Bab-Jesús danikir, anmar-inse gwenadgan-burgwismalad-idugosulid.

Ar Bab-Jesús-sunnad na nibneggi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-ganguedba, anger-dummad-gayaba, degine, Bab-Dummad-gala gollalir, Dummad-Jesús aidedagoed. Geb degine, dulemar Cristogi-bengussuli-burgwismalad-inse durgudagoed.
A-sorbali, anmar-amba-dula-gudimalad, eba seledmarmogoed, mogir-imbaba Bab-Jesús-abinguegar. Degi anmar Bab-Jesúsba mai sadegumaloed.
Degisoggu, we-gaya-burbagi na be muchub-muchub ogannodii imakmarsun, mer dogdar bukib-binsamalagar.
